Who This Is For

Students
Researchers
NGOs
Businesses

Most analysis mistakes happen before a single test is run — the wrong test is chosen for the data type, the hypothesis, or the sample size. Our Statistical Consulting service is the entry point for anyone who isn't sure what their data actually needs.

We walk through your variables, your hypotheses, and your study design, and tell you exactly which statistical approach fits — then, if you want, we run it for you.

What's Included

Test‑selection guidance based on variable type and design
Sample size and power calculations
Study design review
Interpretation support for results you've already run
Ongoing consulting retainers for organizations
Tools we use:SPSSSTATARPythonExcel

How It Works

01

Book a Scoping Call

Tell us your research question, variables, and what you're trying to find out.

02

We Map the Right Method

We match your design to the correct statistical test or modeling approach.

03

Guided or Done‑for‑You

Choose to run it yourself with our guidance, or hand it off entirely.

04

Sign‑off

Why Work With Us

We explain the 'why' behind every recommendation
Works for one‑off questions or ongoing organizational support
No pressure to over‑complicate — simplest correct test wins
Available for both academic and business contexts

Frequently Asked Questions

Do I need to already have data?

No — this service is often used before data collection, to design the study correctly from the start.

Can you review a test I already ran?

Yes, we frequently review and correct analysis that's already been done.

Is this only for students?

No — we support NGOs, companies, and independent researchers just as often.

How is this different from Research Data Analysis?

This service focuses on the decision of what to do; Research Data Analysis focuses on doing it.
